# Security Policy & Responsible Disclosure

## 🔐 Security & Responsible Disclosure
For business inquiries, technical support, partnership opportunities, and security vulnerability reports, please use the official contact details below.

For security reports, include a clear description of the vulnerability, its potential impact, and reproduction steps where applicable. Do not include passwords, API keys, or other sensitive credentials.

## Supported Versions
| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Please **do not** open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.
Send an email directly to [agusdwirianto@gmail.com](mailto:agusdwirianto@gmail.com) with complete replication details.
